rule: Owner 2026-11-17: a type of error seen once is recorded here, not fixed. Every graded lecture is checked for each type; at its second occurrence the type gets one classification, one eval case and one prompt fix.

types.what: two answers to different questions are written as one Claim; the second point has no Claim of its own
types.rule_already_in_prompt: Claim prompt: 「回答不同問題的分開列」
types.check: for each Claim, does its statement answer more than one question?
